premise.claim: Issue #511: during StatefulSet->RoleInstanceSet migration the new RoleInstance uses the same stable Pod name as the removed legacy workload; 'the replacement Pod was not automatically created' and the RoleInstance stayed unready ('pod ... is not controlled by RoleInstance ...') until a manual reconcile, because the old Pod's deletion event does not map to the new RoleInstance.
premise.evidence: Differential harness: on merge-base a0b11e6 a foreign-owned same-name Pod makes Scale return (false, nil) — no error, no requeue (results/unit-base.log: TestOrphanPodContractForeignOwner FAILS, 'An error is expected but got nil'), and the real controller in envtest never records FailedScale nor recreates the Pod after the foreign Pod is GC'd without a manual trigger (results/envtest-base.log: both specs FAIL). On PR head a8ef35f the same tests pass. The pod event handler (pkg/reconciler/roleinstance/instance_event_handler.go resolveControllerRef) only maps events for pods whose controller ref is a RoleInstance, so a foreign Pod's deletion cannot wake the stalled instance — mechanism matches the issue.
match: records FailedScale and retries while a foreign-owned Pod squats the stable name
creates the replacement Pod after the foreign Pod is GC'd, without a manual reconcile

findings.note: Premise: foreign-owned same-name Pod must produce a Scale error (the retry signal). Red on base, green on head.

match: records FailedScale and retries while a foreign-owned Pod squats the stable name
findings.note: Controller records RoleInstanceFailedScale with 'is not controlled by RoleInstance' and leaves the foreign Pod alone (no adopt/delete/replace). Red on base, green on head.

match: creates the replacement Pod after the foreign Pod is GC'd, without a manual reconcile
findings.note: The issue #511 contract: after GC removes the foreign Pod, the retry loop alone creates the replacement Pod owned by the same RoleInstance. Red on base, green on head.
Regression guard: a Pod already controlled by this RoleInstance is skipped without error or duplicate creation. Green on base and head.

Behavior-change pin: on head the first foreign-name collision aborts sibling Pod creation too (base created siblings immediately). Intended all-or-nothing semantics of PR #512; test pins them so any future change is deliberate. Red on base, green on head.
Controller-less same-name Pod (permanent collision) also surfaces as a Scale error now instead of being silently skipped. Red on base, green on head.
